caption: IN THE MATTER OF DISBARMENT OF RICHARD JOSEPH SILVERBERG
text: Richard Joseph Silverberg, of Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, having been suspended from the practice of law in this Court by order of September 5, 2025; and a rule having been issued and served upon him requiring him to show cause why he should not be disbarred; and a response having been filed; It is ordered that Richard Joseph Silverberg is disbarred from the practice of law in this Court.
